title: 5ire Client Vulnerable to Cross-Site Scripting and Remote Code Execution
interaction_dependency: MCP client used to connect an agent to external servers; not by itself evidence of a multi-agent failure
vulnerability_or_mechanism: stored XSS in chatbot responses and unsafe Electron protocol handling
impact: remote code execution

title: Anthropic Slack MCP Server zero-click data exfiltration via link unfurling
interaction_dependency: An AI agent processes untrusted data and posts an attacker-crafted URL; Slack preview services create the outbound exfiltration request.
vulnerability_or_mechanism: prompt-influenced hyperlink generation combined with automatic link unfurling
impact: zero-click exfiltration of sensitive data

title: MCP Python SDK streamable HTTP session exception denial of service
interaction_dependency: A malicious MCP client can deliberately trigger an exception after opening a streamable HTTP session.
vulnerability_or_mechanism: uncaught ClosedResourceError after a client-triggered exception
impact: server crash requiring restart

title: MCP Python SDK FastMCP validation error denial of service
interaction_dependency: Malformed requests sent through the MCP transport can terminate the FastMCP server path.
vulnerability_or_mechanism: unhandled validation exception
impact: service unavailability until restart

title: Lara Translate MCP Server command injection
interaction_dependency: An MCP server is an agent-tool interaction endpoint; this record is contextual unless deployed between separately addressable agents
vulnerability_or_mechanism: unsanitized import_tmx parameters passed to child_process.exec
impact: remote code execution

title: Cursor MCP install deeplink hides command arguments
interaction_dependency: The flaw crosses an MCP installation trust boundary but is not inherently multi-agent
vulnerability_or_mechanism: hidden command arguments in a social-engineering installation flow

title: Agno MultiMCPTools command injection
interaction_dependency: The vulnerable MCPTools or MultiMCPTools handler constructs operating-system commands from attacker-controlled configuration.
vulnerability_or_mechanism: OS command injection through the command argument
impact: remote command execution

title: MCP Inspector command execution through an untrusted MCP server
interaction_dependency: The vulnerable path is an inspector-to-untrusted-server interaction

title: Unauthorized control of litmus MCP service

title: MCP Data Science Server command injection

vulnerability_or_mechanism: unsafe Python exec with unrestricted builtins

title: DNS rebinding protection disabled by default in MCP Python SDK

title: 5ire remote code execution through Mermaid rendering
